reason: A is the stronger proposal because a continuous Cr-derived interfacial layer directly targets molten-Al ingress and is tested against an uncoated baseline with phase and penetration measurements. B’s sparse ZrC dispersion is unlikely to provide a continuous barrier, its chemical inertness in molten Al is insufficiently justified, and its cited evidence concerns aqueous NaCl corrosion of an HEA coating rather than molten-aluminum attack; A is still weakened by lacking prior evidence and by its arbitrary 30% threshold.
